Maya (People Ops): quick q 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1  i rode with two colleagues to the airport using a pooled rideshare and paid the full fare. how do we split the claim?
Owen (Engineer): i've done that. i uploaded the single rideshare receipt + a short allocation note listing each person's share and linked the flight calendar entry. finance accepted it.
Claire (Recruiter): for candidate pickups we sometimes combine rides. do we need manager approval to split across attendees?
Priya (Finance): rules: business-related rides are reimbursable. for pooled rides pay attention to personal detours. preferred: merchant receipt + allocation note (names + amounts) + supporting context (meeting invite or candidate slot). if the receipt shows an itemized split from the app, upload that and that's ideal.
Maya (People Ops): what if the receipt only shows total and tip as one charge and one colleague paid cash for tip?
Priya (Finance): include card statement showing the total and add an allocation note that specifies how tip was handled. if tip was cash and one person didn't want to be reimbursed for tip, mark that portion as personal.
Owen (Engineer): currency FX? my card charged in local currency on a trip to MXN.
Priya (Finance): upload the card stmt showing the charge. finance will convert using txn date FX. no extra conversion doc needed.
Maya (People Ops): any naming convention to speed approvals?
Priya (Finance): yes: `lastname_1819994321_rideshare_receipt.jpg` and allocation note `lastname_1819994321_alloc.txt`. include manager_ok.png if the split involved non-employees or special approval.
ExpenseBot: REMINDER 1: For pooled rides: upload original merchant receipt + an allocation note with name/amount per claimant. Mark any personal detours or cash tips as personal.
Claire (Recruiter): thanks all, i'll assemble the allocation now and submit. :thumbsup:
